title: RAW UNREVIEWED: default-vowel bodies with consonant doubling as vowel suppression
summary: A fixed22-unit writing relation has17consonant bodies and5literal vowel units. A consonant plus one fixed default vowel writes its body alone; a consonant plus another vowel writes body+vowel; a bare consonant writes its body twice. Word boundaries remain. Reading returns all exactly re-encodable source strings, since cc can be C or CACA and cv can be CV or CAV. No native sounds, source language, lexicon or statistical match is supplied.

design.mechanism: A default-vowel spelling channel whose explicit vowel-suppression operation copies the consonant body rather than using a separate cancellation mark. Ambiguity is retained, not silently resolved.
design.unit: Source letter/phoneme tokens within exactly preserved source words; one complete source word becomes one written group. These tokens are abstract until an input orthography/phonology is independently fixed.
design.contrast: GDT892/905/906 free prefix-code CV inventory; GDT1219 source-trained126-cell context defaults; IDEA932 explicit vowel runs and initial carrier; minim ambiguity975/1006. The new precise law is context-sensitive one-default-vowel consumption plus body-specific doubling for a bare consonant.
design.prediction: Every source consonant without an immediately following vowel forces one literal equal-unit adjacency inside its output word; complete source-word type diversity cannot increase. These are key-renaming-invariant necessary consequences before any native lexical fit.

source_domain.words: Any nonempty finite token sequence over those22source tokens. Preserve the exact sequence of nonempty words. This finite22-token domain has no punctuation, digit, unknown-token or literal escape branch. Any mapping from a historical source into it requires a separately fixed normalization/transcription with every loss disclosed.
source_domain.capacity_limit: 17+5 allocates the existing22working drawings; it is an invented convention, not a recovered phoneme inventory or claim that any particular medieval language has precisely these sounds.

design.key: One fixed bijection maps C1..C17,V1..V5 to the22complete working units. No specific key, vowel class or native sound value is chosen. Parse complete units before applying this relation.
encoder_pseudocode: For each source word set i=0 and output=[]; no cross-word state.
If word[i] is a vowel V: append key(V); increment i by1.
If word[i] is a consonant C and next token exists and is V1: append key(C); increment i by2.
If word[i] is a consonant C and next token is a vowel V other than V1: append key(C),key(V); increment i by2.
Otherwise word[i] is a consonant C followed by another consonant or word end: append key(C),key(C); increment i by1.
Repeat until the complete word is consumed; preserve its outer word boundary. No optional deletion, style choice, extra spaces or END mark.
inverse_pseudocode: Given one fixed key and a written whole-word unit sequence y of lengthn, reverse the key to identify the body/vowel symbols.

Enumerate segmentation candidates using these output/source alternatives: vowel unit v→V; consonant unit c→C,V1; adjacent identical consonant units cc→C; consonant unit c followed by nondefault vowel v→C,V.

Concatenate each candidate source-token sequence. Re-encode it with the deterministic greedy encoder, and retain it IF AND ONLY IF its complete output equals y exactly. This final canonicality test is mandatory: local block inversions can violate the forward lookahead condition at their boundaries.

Return the deduplicated finite set. Every source candidate has length at most2n; alternatively exhaustive enumeration up to2n followed by exact re-encoding defines the same inverse independently of the segmentation implementation.

No lexicon/grammar selects a preferred candidate in this raw model. Unique plaintext and unique meaning are NOT guaranteed; independent source language constraints would be substantive added information.

source_only_examples.point: cc can be a bare consonant or two default-vowel syllables. This is real content ambiguity.
Ambiguity is not confined to doubled bodies: CV versus CAV also collides.
A separately written default vowel after a body represents an additional vowel here, not a freely interchangeable spelling of the inherent vowel.
The bare first consonant doubles; the second consonant consumes the default vowel.

exact_obligations.bare_consonant_self_pairs: Let B be the total number of source consonants immediately followed by a consonant or word end. In the complete output let R=sum overwords of equal-adjacent-unit pairs, counting overlapping pairs. Then R>=B. Each bare-consonant output occupies its own two consecutive positions, so its internal equal edge is distinct from that forced by every other bare consonant; mergers can only add equal edges.
exact_obligations.length: For each word Lout=Lsource+B-D, where D counts source consonants immediately followed by V1. Equivalent: Lout=2Nc+Nv-Ncv-NcV1. All counts concern the frozen source tokens, not guessed native phonemes.
exact_obligations.diversity: One deterministic spelling per exact source word implies outputtypes<=sourcetypes in the same complete word sample. Collisions can only merge types. The sum of the top10 outputcounts is at least the sum of top10 sourcecounts, since those ten source types occupy at most ten outputs.
exact_obligations.allstrings_warning: Every written unit sequence has a source preimage obtained by expanding each consonant body to C,V1 and each vowel unit to V. Therefore all-string parseability is automatic and cannot be reported as native support. A meaningful test must use independently fixed source content or licensed vocabulary/grammar and include its ambiguity/collision cost.

design.positive_baseline_relation: Repeated consonant bodies and reused ordered body/vowel combinations are produced by explicit rules, while lexical source distributions can preserve whole-form effects. This describes a possible mechanism; it neither proves the observed alternation statistic nor explains all native morphology, q/o preferences, endings or layout.
design.smallest_necessary_check: Do NOT build a decoder first. If root independently fixes an admissible source projection, compute its B and exact Lout and compare the forced within-word equal-pair lower bound R>=B to an already admitted native summary under the same group contract; also apply the type/concentration invariant. These are genuine observable constraints, not another roundtrip or allstrings-capacity demonstration. No source/native count is performed here.
design.known_fixed_source_stop: GDT1202 already excludes even two output variants per sourceword on its four fixed8000-word source projections. A faithful one-output-per-word instantiation is stricter and cannot rescue those comparisons. Because this raw22-token domain has not been matched to those exact projections, no silent stripping/merging/new corpus is allowed to evade that limitation. The old source-screen failures remain, not new results.

predecessors.scope: Their fixed free prefix-code/lexicon/grammar complete failure remains. This proposal intentionally abandons free unique recovery; no old key is revived.
126trained defaults pluslast-vowel memory differ from the one invariant default and body doubling. Its four-source frequency and length failures remain.
Its all-vowel explicit stacked marks/initial empty carrier are different; no new2Dglyph binding or additional mark is assumed here.
Set-valued inversion is already known, not new. Here all17consonant bodies have a specific vowel-suppression double; no e/i minim style, encodedSPACEor reference repair.
General freelyUDcode closure does not apply to this deliberately ambiguous greedy relation; grammar-assisted ambiguity was already outside that result.
Fixed source-word statistical obstruction must be checked before any implementation or corpus substitution.
